description: Derive a message's routing key from its declared routing members. Each routing member has an explicit position; members are read in ascending position order and each value is rendered as a culture-invariant string (so a decimal is rendered with a dot as decimal separator regardless of locale), then the rendered parts are joined with dots to form the routing key. A message that declares no routing members produces the special match-all token. A routing member whose value is missing/null is rejected with a normalized error that reports the offending member's position. The output reports the routing key and its part count, or the normalized error.
